digests.title: TLDR Daily Digest
digests.tagline: AI, IT, Web Dev, InfoSec, DevOps, Design

stories.headline: Periodic Neon Outperforms Frontier Models on Scientific Tasks
stories.blurb: This new midtrained and RL-optimized model establishes a Pareto-optimal cost-performance frontier, surpassing OpenAI's and Anthropic's top models on specialized scientific analysis.

stories.headline: System One Models Introduce Fast, Hallucination-Free AI Automation
stories.blurb: Jev, a new class of frontier model, returns typed probabilistic decisions instead of generated text, running two orders of magnitude faster and significantly cheaper on structured automation workloads.

stories.headline: Google Releases Gemini 3.8 Live with Real-Time Audio Reasoning
stories.blurb: The new Gemini 3.8 Live and Extended Thinking models allow developers to build voice applications that can maintain low latency while processing background reasoning.

stories.headline: Reallocating Compute Solves the "Matthew Effect" in LLM RL Post-Training
stories.blurb: Researchers proposed a "Never Give Up" reinforcement learning strategy that shifts compute away from easy tasks to continuously sample and solve harder, previously failed tasks.

stories.headline: Why the AI Revolution Is Making Software More Expensive
stories.blurb: Despite dropping AI inference costs, software prices are rising as Jevons paradox drives up consumption and feature expectations, shifting enterprise pricing models.

stories.headline: Logitech Logi Options+ Defect Grants SYSTEM Privileges on Windows
stories.blurb: A newly patched vulnerability (CVE-2026-12518) in Logitech's software allowed standard local users to trigger unsigned installer executions and gain full SYSTEM administrative shells.

stories.headline: Extortion Group FulcrumSec Bypasses Endpoint Security via Token Theft
stories.blurb: A deep dive into FulcrumSec shows how the threat group scans public repos to harvest credentials and pivot through AWS and GitHub without triggering traditional malware alerts.

stories.headline: Mass-Scanning Campaign Targets Vite Flaw to Steal Cloud Credentials
stories.blurb: Threat actors are actively exploiting a Vite development server vulnerability (CVE-2026-39364) to bypass file restrictions and extract sensitive environment and cloud profile files.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Lets Sites Block AI Training While Preserving Search Visibility
stories.blurb: A new "Disallow AI Training" setting lets publishers stop AI crawlers from scraping their data without losing SEO rankings across search engines like Google and Bing.

stories.headline: Cilium 1.20 Enhances Enterprise Networking and Custom eBPF Datapaths
stories.blurb: The landmark release introduces a third-party datapath plugin architecture, external authentication for the Gateway API, and stable promotion of Kubernetes Multi-Cluster Services.

stories.headline: Canva Unveils ProSuite as a Direct Competitor to Adobe Creative Cloud
stories.blurb: Canva has unified its acquisitions of Affinity, Cavalry, Flourish, and Leonardo into a single creative platform featuring professional tools, AI integrations, and automated workflows.

stories.headline: Why the UX Double Diamond Model is Collapsing in the AI Era
stories.blurb: Low-cost AI prototyping has shifted the core design bottleneck from upfront ideation and construction to "judgment budget"—the evaluation of numerous automatically generated variations.

stories.headline: Figma Enlists AI to Turn UI Designers into Custom Plugin Developers
stories.blurb: Figma’s new AI capability can generate fully functional, customized plugins from plain-language prompts to automate tedious UI and prototyping tasks.
